folds.heading: ## Full cultivation-checkpoint content reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Read the whole checkpoint through the visitor and generated-output releases. Later native receipts supersede their matching active/pending notes, while the all-fitting CG01–CG29 scope, CG30 source boundary and 154-row variants remain separate. The later scope correction removes the retired prestige gate without claiming later-layer implementation. A family pilot, headcount, title, property or module does not close every source variant (AD32, AD36, AD43). No private source or evidence payload was reopened here.

Preserve the actual mechanism chains: a cradle alone supplies no field; learned focus does not supply fuel; studies/admission/employment do not create combat qualification; physical curriculum raises capacity without filling vitals; rest/food actually recover them. Attention patterns divide existing work rather than create independent people. Lasting material treatment, learned habit/law memory, current-body conditioning and a carried physical copy have different retention. The school circuit is a funded forms comparison, the cohort uses real native bodies, and the outdoor survey has actual jobs/arrival/presence; none proves armies or general territory simulation. Local floor/cap/food/failure/residue/affinity numbers remain authored policies, not universal costs or world laws (AD5, AD38).

Keep the diagnostic corrections alongside their later proof: full-HP recovery cannot spend a healing charge; two physical strips require distinguishable receipt identity; quantized XP concealed the first maintenance comparison until a real threshold was crossed; display failure interrupted fixture inventory publication and was repaired at that seam; an already-exhausted fighter was double-scaled; a journal repaint discarded an unsaved draft. Failed driver selectors, stale builds, hidden disclosures, decimal parsing and genuine shortages are not all runtime defects. The source-rewind U1 repair preserves ordinary rewind and excludes only the exact reserved departed-copy point; U4 separates failed durability from post-durable error. B170/B201 and current receiving owners qualify the old separately owned U3 absence rather than reproducing it here.

Each frozen suite belongs to its own manifest and postdates only the listed changes. The repeated near-green cultivation suites retained their one reported LOTM import failure; later visitor focused/native proof does not retrospectively turn them all green. The final six-person attacking side/eight total fighters receipt is a real bounded technical release, not all cultivation or source-canon completion. Its later primary executable/index/notices equality and explained 37 dependency-path-only source-map differences support the recorded relevant receipt reuse, not newly executed primary tests or normal-app adoption. Preserve body-aging/custody/territory/institution and other Coverage gaps, private evidence and every earlier failed proof window. Historical reservations, PIDs, storage-cleanup messages, commits/adoption boundaries and maintenance intent are not current instructions. No runtime, cleanup, process action, new source reading or publication occurred in this review.
